SHOW CAUSE NOTICE FOR DECENTRALIZED CRYPTO MINING TAXATION
Notice Ref: CRYPTO/GST/2023/505 Dated 10-01-2024
GSTIN: 27EEEEE2222E1Z2 M/s HashBlock Technologies
FY: 2022-23

1. It is alleged that taxpayer performed validation of proof-of-work blockchain transactions and received block rewards in virtual digital assets without discharging 28% GST on consensus validation services.
2. Show cause why GST of Rs. 15,00,000/- on block rewards should not be recovered.
